items.summary: Find what a change can break in the code that did NOT change — trace a diff, branch, commit range, or named feature outward through callers, consumers, shared state, and contracts, rank the concrete regression scenarios by blast radius, and prove or clear each one with an observed test run. Use this skill whenever the user says "look for regressions", "what could this break", "did this change break anything", "regression check", "impact of this change", "blast radius", "what else uses this", "is anything else affected", or "/regression-hunt" — even if they don't name the skill. latestVersion.changelog:
Skill-manager 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Provides automated inventory and deep analysis of all installed Plugins/Skills, including dependencies and risk levels.
- Assesses task complexity and matches suitable Skills, recommending alternatives from online repositories for complex tasks.
- Estimates and compares token cost and execution time for using existing Skills, built-in tools, or generating new scripts.
- Generates structured, easy-to-review reports and never auto-executes; user always selects the preferred execution path.
- Includes a detailed risk assessment framework for skill evaluation and recommendations.
